title: Report: Jaguars OT Anton Harrison to have knee surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Jaguars OT Anton Harrison to have knee surgery
sources.description: The Jaguars won't have left tackle Anton Harrison in the lineup against the Texans in Week 6 and it's unclear when he will be back in action.
